_doc: FROZEN discrete-neighborhood registry for the OPA-gate experiment (NEW_EXPS_8 gap 4). Each d=1 discrete edge an adversary may traverse carries a MECHANISM tag from the TM2 attacker taxonomy. Edges with no assignable mechanism do NOT go in (they are listed under excluded_fields with a reason). This converts the discrete neighborhood from a free parameter into a threat-model-derived object. Freeze this table BEFORE running the oracle; the runners enforce that the oracle only traverses registered edges.

tm2_mechanisms.multiplexing_confusion: The agent multiplexes several tools/endpoints; a typed return is attributed to the WRONG tool identity (tool swap). The numeric value is read under a different tool's threshold.
tm2_mechanisms.schema_migration: A field's schema/label set changed across versions; an old value is interpreted under a new schema (categorical value swap within a field whose meaning migrated).
tm2_mechanisms.stale_cache: A provenance attribute (jurisdiction, network/geo, KYC tier) is served from a stale cache and no longer matches the live binding, so the threshold selected for it is wrong.
tm2_mechanisms.policy_pack_confusion: The wrong policy pack / environment binding is applied (env/tier/registry pack), selecting a different threshold for the same numeric value.

provenance_tiers.third_party_rego: Unmodified third-party policy (Gatekeeper/OPA bundle). Strongest evidence: removes authorship of threshold logic.
provenance_tiers.third_party_logic_reimplemented: The documented idiom of a third-party policy re-expressed as executable Rego for this experiment (logic faithful to a public source, but re-typed). Intermediate evidence.
provenance_tiers.authored_rego: Rego authored for this experiment (provenance-conditioned thresholds), evaluated by OPA. Controlled-mechanism evidence; labels flow through an executable engine but authorship is ours.
provenance_tiers.python_fallback: Debugging only; must NOT appear in main results.

excluded_fields.entity_type: inert: the authored policy threshold does not depend on entity_type, and no TM2 mechanism re-binds it across a threshold.

excluded_fields.region: inert: the suppression threshold does not depend on region; no mechanism re-binds it across a threshold.

excluded_fields.device: inert: the login threshold does not depend on device posture; no mechanism re-binds it across a threshold.

excluded_fields.env: inert: no vendored Gatekeeper policy reads the env label, and no TM2 mechanism crosses a policy boundary by re-binding env.
